title: Hammer (DS)
wikitext:
{{Item |image=[[File:Hammer (FoMT).png]] |name=Hammer |obtain by=Starting Tool }} The '''Hammer''' is an essential tool in [[Harvest Moon DS]], which is available in the inventory immediately. It is used to break stones and boulders to obtain Material Stone, and can flatten tilled land. ==Upgrades== {|border="1" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" style="width:500px;text-align:center;" ! style="width:10%;background-color:rgb(123, 204, 112);"|Type ! style="width:10%;background-color:rgb(123, 204, 112);"|Strength ! style="width:10%;background-color:rgb(123, 204, 112);"|Stamina Usage ! style="width:10%;background-color:rgb(123, 204, 112);"|Description |- | [[File:Hammer (FoMT).png]]
Hammer | Can only break small stones. | 2 | Breaks stones and fences, not boulders. Prepares land. |- | [[File:Copper Hammer (FoMT).png]]
Copper Hammer | Breaks smooth rocks in 3 strikes. Cannot break boulders. | 4 | Breaks stones, rocks, fences, not boulders. Prepares land. |- | [[File:Silver Hammer (FoMT).png]]
Silver Hammer | Breaks smooth rocks in 2 strikes and boulders in 6. | 5 | rowspan=3 | Breaks stones, rocks, fences, and boulders. Prepares land. |- | [[File:Gold Hammer (FoMT).png]]
Gold Hammer | Breaks smooth rocks in 1 strike and boulders in 3 strikes. | 8 |- | [[File:Mystrile Hammer (FoMT).png]]

Cursed Hammer | Breaks all stones in a 11x11 area in front of the player | 15 | You can't put it down! Call the Church to remove. |- | [[File:Blessed Hammer (FoMT).png]]
Blessed Hammer | Breaks all stones in a 11x11 area in front of the player | 15 | It's been cured of its curse! |- | [[File:Mythic Hammer (FoMT).png]]
